CHAPTER X.
The Lobster Quadrille


The Mock Turtle and Gryphon demonstrated the Lobster Quadrille, a
dance involving lobsters thrown out to sea, and sang the song of the
whiting and the snail. Alice then recounted her strange day's
adventures, and attempted to recite "'Tis the voice of the Lobster,"
though the words again came out strangely different from what she
expected.
